Oak Ridge Investments LLC Sells 34,462 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Mar 15th, 2018 
Oak Ridge Investments LLC decreased its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.4% during the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 333,764 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 34,462 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 2.1% of Oak Ridge Investments LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 5th largest position. Oak Ridge Investments LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $51,440,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Other institutional investors and hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of the company. Thompson Investment Management Inc. lifted its holdings in Apple by 3.0% during the third quarter. Thompson Investment Management Inc. now owns 13,522 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,084,000 after purchasing an additional 396 shares in the last quarter. Welch Investments LLC lifted its holdings in Apple by 18.7% during the third quarter. Welch Investments LLC now owns 1,907 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $294,000 after purchasing an additional 300 shares in the last quarter. Quantbot Technologies LP purchased a new position in Apple during the third quarter valued at approximately $8,278,000. Putnam FL Investment Management Co. purchased a new position in Apple during the third quarter valued at approximately $37,671,000. Finally, IBM Retirement Fund lifted its holdings in Apple by 1.4% during the third quarter. IBM Retirement Fund now owns 129,530 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $21,973,000 after purchasing an additional 1,768 shares in the last quarter. 61.41% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. AAPL has been the topic of several analyst reports. Vetr downgraded shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $178.34 price target on the stock. in a report on Friday, December 1st. UBS Group set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, January 5th. Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price target (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 23rd. Sanford C. Bernstein downgraded shares of Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and lowered their target price for the stock from $195.00 to $170.00 in a report on Friday, February 2nd. Finally, HSBC set a $204.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, January 30th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.57. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $178.44 on Thursday. Apple Inc. has a one year low of $138.62 and a one year high of $183.50. The firm has a market cap of $905,410.00, a PE ratio of 17.46, a P/E/G ratio of 1.36 and a beta of 1.22. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $3.36 earnings per share. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current year. 
The firm also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were paid a $0.63 dividend. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.41%. The ex-dividend date was Friday, February 9th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 24.66%.
